title: Avicena, which links AI chips with microLEDs instead of lasers, raised a $100M+ Series C led by Intervest, with participation from SK Hynix, Samsung, and AMD (Cristian Dina/The Next Web)
summary: Cristian Dina / The Next Web: Avicena, which links AI chips with microLEDs instead of lasers, raised a $100M+ Series C led by Intervest, with participation from SK Hynix, Samsung, and AMD — SK hynix, Samsung and AMD's venture arms joined the Series C. New chief executive Kevin Pope plans to bring the first LightBundle product to market next year.
